summary: Modules and module_utils may only import the standard library unchecked, while other plugins may also import ansible-core and its public dependencies Jinja2, PyYAML and MarkupSafe.
questions: Can my lookup plugin import Jinja2 without a try/except?
Which imports are allowed unchecked in modules?

answer_card.title: Allowed unchecked imports
answer_card.answer_md:
- **modules / module_utils** (core or collections): standard library only.
- **other plugins**: standard library, ansible-core itself, and its public dependencies **Jinja2**, **PyYAML** and **MarkupSafe**.

Everything else must be guarded.
